parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets: it corrects the mischaracterization of the Johnson et al. reference (noting it lacks concrete instructions), fixes the conflation of 'explicit' with 'concrete' implementation detail when describing the motivating example request, and removes the incorrect score-5 mapping without stating a numeric final score. The text is coherent, avoids direct score or gold-label statements, and can be used inside <reasoning> tags for rescoring.
